page.heading: Payment Terms
page.subtitle: Manage payment terms for clients and suppliers

empty.title: No payment terms
empty.message: Create your first payment term to get started.

form.name: Name
form.type_hint: How payment timing is calculated. Net = fixed days after invoice. Due on Receipt = immediate. COD = pay on delivery. Proximate = due on a specific day of the month.
form.net_days_hint: Number of days after the invoice date when the full amount is due.
form.discount_days_hint: Number of days within which the buyer can pay to receive the early payment discount.
form.discount_percent_bps_hint: Early payment discount in basis points. 100 BPS = 1%. Example: 200 = 2% discount.
form.priority_hint: Lower numbers appear first in dropdown lists.
form.name_info: Display name shown in dropdowns and on documents (e.g. Net 30, Due on Receipt).
form.code_info: Short machine-readable identifier used internally (e.g. net_30). Must be unique. Auto-generated from the name if left blank.
form.description_info: Optional notes explaining when or how this payment term applies.
form.type_info: Net = fixed days after invoice date. Due on Receipt = due immediately. COD = pay on delivery. Proximate = due on a fixed day of the month.
form.net_days_hint_updated: Days until due (0 = immediate). Required for Net type.
form.proximate_day_info: Fixed day of the month invoices fall due. For example, 15 means every invoice is due on the 15th of its target month. If the day doesn't exist in a given month (29, 30, or 31 in shorter months — e.g. 31 in February), the due date falls back to the last day of that month.
form.discount_days_info: Optional early-payment window. If the buyer pays within this many days, the discount applies.
form.discount_percent_bps_info: Optional early-payment discount in basis points (200 = 2.00%).
form.is_default_info: When checked, this term is the default for its entity scope (client, supplier, or both).

errors.net_days_required: Net Days is required for Net type.
errors.proximate_day_required: Proximate Day is required for Proximate type.
